document: PDV 2.0 ORIGIN adapter split -- tranche 2 manifest (Khajiit + Argonian)

source.trancheRegion: lines 2969-5535 (ORIGIN tranche 2 header through the tranche 3 header)
source.note: Bodies were copied VERBATIM and machine-verified byte-identical against the base. The originals were deliberately LEFT IN PLACE for the central removal pass; a same-signature child function is simply an override, so the duplication compiles.

verification.compile: tools/pdv_compile.mjs --script PDV_OriginRuntime_Khajiit --script PDV_OriginRuntime_Argonian --skip-verify -- exit 0, 0 errors / 0 warnings on both
verification.bodyParity: 134/134 copied bodies matched the base source byte-for-byte (substring check on latin1 bytes)
verification.laneSeparation: machine-checked: ZERO calls from a Khajiit body into an Argonian body or vice versa, and ZERO calls from either lane into a t1/t3/t4/t5 lane body. Both lanes are self-contained apart from base/t6 infra.

Khajiit.scriptVariablesMovedEvidence: Every reference to all nine sits inside base lines 3878-4065, i.e. wholly inside the Khajiit lane bodies (BeginKhajiitMoonObservation / ProcessPendingKhajiitMoonObservation / IsValidKhajiitMoonObservationContext / CompleteKhajiitMoonObservation / IsKhajiitMoonObservationJsonValid / GetKhajiitMoonObservationDeityKey). Nothing on the base or another lane touches them, so they move whole and need no accessor pair.

crossCuttingFindings.severity: HIGH -- blocks a faithful call-site remap for BOTH races
crossCuttingFindings.finding: HandleContextualSignal(String signalId, Form contextForm = None, Float magnitude = 0.0) has no String payload slot, but nearly every named handler in tranche 2 takes a "String reason" and every live caller passes a DYNAMIC value ("eventbus_" + eventType at PDV_EventBus.psc:239/276/291/312/333/348/363/396/411/731/747/763/779/789/809/819, "mcm" at PDV__ManagerQuest.psc:6120-6156, "eventbus_p2_khajiit_focused_" + sourceId at PDV_EventBus.psc:503/512/524).
crossCuttingFindings.consequenceIfIgnored: The dispatch layer currently passes signalId in place of reason, so the remap would collapse ~20 distinct provenance strings per race into one constant. Reason strings surface in the Ledger, so this is player-visible.
crossCuttingFindings.recommendedFix: Add a defaulted trailing parameter to the base virtual: Bool Function HandleContextualSignal(String signalId, Form contextForm = None, Float magnitude = 0.0, String reason = ""). A defaulted parameter is backwards compatible and inert, exactly like the Manager.SetDawnHadActivity accessor precedent. This is a BASE change and is deliberately NOT made here.

crossCuttingFindings.severity: HIGH -- ApplyCurseHandlers cannot be overridden by EITHER race
crossCuttingFindings.finding: The frozen base virtual is Function ApplyCurseHandlers() with no parameters, but ApplyKhajiitCurseHandlers(Int oldState, Int newState, String reason) and ApplyArgonianCurseHandlers(Int oldState, Int newState, String reason) both take three. Papyrus has no overloading and matches overrides by signature, so declaring the three-argument form in the adapter is a compile error.
crossCuttingFindings.consequenceIfIgnored: PDV_DevotionLedger.psc:4250 and :4258 have no virtual to remap onto; curse-state transitions would silently stop reaching the race lane.
crossCuttingFindings.recommendedFix: Change the base virtual to Function ApplyCurseHandlers(Int oldState = 0, Int newState = 0, String reason = ""). Defaults keep it inert. All ten races appear to have the same three-argument shape, so this is one base edit, not a per-race workaround. NOT made here (base is frozen for this task).

crossCuttingFindings.finding: ShowOriginNotification(String messageKey) cannot delegate to ShowKhajiitMessage(Message messageRecord, String fallbackText, Bool suppressModal) or ShowArgonianMessage(Message messageRecord, String fallback, Bool suppressModal) -- the caller supplies a Message RECORD, not a key. PDV__ManagerQuest.psc:3606 passes PDV_Msg_Khajiit_CurseState_ShadowDriftEntry directly.
crossCuttingFindings.consequenceIfIgnored: The one external ShowKhajiitMessage call site has nowhere to remap to.
crossCuttingFindings.recommendedFix: Either widen the virtual to ShowOriginNotification(Message messageRecord, String fallbackText = "", Bool suppressModal = False), or keep a per-race key table inside the adapter that maps a String key to the Message property. The second keeps the frozen signature but needs a key table nobody has specified yet.

crossCuttingFindings.finding: HandleLocationChange() is zero-argument but PDV_ActionRouter.psc:314 calls UpdateArgonianSanctuaryActive(akNewLocation) and :334 calls HandleArgonianSacredWaterDiscovery(akNewLocation) -- both need the NEW location, which is not the same as GetCurrentLocation() at every point in the event.
crossCuttingFindings.consequenceIfIgnored: Substituting Game.GetPlayer().GetCurrentLocation() would be a silent behaviour change in the Eldergleam arm/disarm path.
crossCuttingFindings.recommendedFix: Widen the base virtual to Function HandleLocationChange(Location newLocation = None, Location oldLocation = None). Both are already routed through HandleContextualSignal("sanctuary-active" / "sacred-water-discovery", contextForm) in this adapter as an interim, which works because Location is a Form.

crossCuttingFindings.severity: MEDIUM -- three Khajiit call sites have no home in the frozen interface
crossCuttingFindings.finding: HandleContextualSignal returns Bool meaning HANDLED, so a handler whose own return value matters cannot ride it. Three cross-boundary Khajiit entry points return a value: TryUseKhajiitAzurahPortent(Actor) -> Bool (PDV_KhajiitAzurahPortentEffect.psc:12), CanExecuteKhajiitBaanDarRescue(Actor) -> Bool (PDV_KhajiitBaanDarRescueEffect.psc:12), BeginKhajiitMoonObservation(Actor) -> Int (PDV_ObserveMoonsEffect.psc:33). They are deliberately ABSENT from the Khajiit signal map.
crossCuttingFindings.recommendedFix: Add a keyed Bool/Int action verb to the base, e.g. Bool Function TryOriginAction(String actionId, Form contextForm = None) and Int Function BeginOriginAction(String actionId, Form contextForm = None). Until then these three magic-effect scripts must keep calling the named functions.

crossCuttingFindings.severity: MEDIUM -- a whole class, not one call
crossCuttingFindings.finding: GetOriginDetailLabel(String)/GetOriginDetailValue(String) carry no numeric argument, so the many cross-boundary readers that take an INDEX cannot be expressed: GetKhajiitFocusLabel(Int) (9 call sites, several with an arbitrary focus -- PDV_MCM.psc:2018, PDV__ManagerQuest.psc:2521/2522/2751/6528/7966), GetKhajiitFocusStandingLine(Int), GetKhajiitFocusSymbol(Int), GetKhajiitFocusWeightKey(Int) (PDV__ManagerQuest.psc:6520/6524 iterate over ALL focus values), GetKhajiitLunarTierLabel(Int), GetKhajiitLunarPostureDisplayLabelAt(Int), GetKhajiitLunarPostureReadout(Int), GetKhajiitEmphasisDeity(Int), GetKhajiitFocusForDeity(PDV_DeityBase), GetLunarPresidingFocus(Int), GetKhajiitMoonPhaseFromGameDay(Float), GetArgonianLayerStrengthLabel(Float), GetArgonianVoidStrengthLabel(Float), GetArgonianCulturalNextThresholdText(Float), BridgeKhajiitMatrixFocus(String, String).
crossCuttingFindings.mitigationApplied: Every detail key in this manifest resolves against the CURRENT focus/posture/tier, which covers the display call sites that already read current state. Call sites that pass an arbitrary index are NOT covered.
crossCuttingFindings.recommendedFix: Add an argument-carrying pair to the base: String Function GetOriginDetailLabelFor(String detailKey, Int index) and the Float/Form variants, or accept that these stay named lane reads until a later pass.

crossCuttingFindings.severity: HIGH -- these break the moment the central pass deletes the originals from the base
crossCuttingFindings.finding: Seven tranche-6 (base, non-race) bodies call tranche-2 lane functions directly. They are bare in-script calls today, so removing the originals from the base will not compile: HandlePlayerSleepStop -> HandleKhajiitRoadHome and -> HandleArgonianSleepEvents; HandleSubstrateActionEvent -> GetArgonianCulturalPracticeLabel; HandlePlayerBelowHealthGate -> TryArgonianSithisNearDeathBurst; ApplyUndeadCryptClearReaction -> BridgeKhajiitMatrixFocus; GetMedallionSectionsJson -> GetKhajiitMedallionEntriesJson and -> GetArgonianMedallionEntriesJson.
crossCuttingFindings.recommendedFix: Each of these must become a virtual call on Self during the central removal pass: the three signal-shaped ones map onto HandleContextualSignal("road-home" / "sleep-events" / "sithis-near-death"), the two medallion reads onto GetOriginDetailLabel("medallion-entries"), the practice label onto GetOriginStateLabel(). BridgeKhajiitMatrixFocus has no home yet (two String arguments -- see REASON-PAYLOAD and ARG-TAKING-READERS).

crossCuttingFindings.finding: GetKhajiitLunarAlignmentMultiplier(PDV_DeityBase deity) has ZERO call sites anywhere in live-source. It is shaped exactly like the provider verb GetProviderGainMultiplier(PDV_DeityBase, Int) but the ADR assigns provider overrides only to _Orc and _Imperial. Copied into the Khajiit adapter unchanged and NOT wired to the provider virtual.
crossCuttingFindings.recommendedFix: Decide during the provider-seam pass whether this is dead code or an unlanded Khajiit provider factor. Do not delete it on the strength of "no references" alone.

crossCuttingFindings.severity: LOW -- already handled, recorded so the next adapter author does not lose an hour
crossCuttingFindings.finding: Naming the detail-accessor parameter "key" (as the base virtual does) is a COMPILE ERROR in any adapter that actually reads it: Papyrus is case-insensitive and resolves the identifier to Skyrim's Key script type, producing "key is not a variable". The base gets away with it only because its default body never references the parameter.
crossCuttingFindings.resolution: Both adapters name the parameter detailKey. Papyrus matches overrides by type, not by parameter name, so this does not break the override. Every other adapter will hit this.
